text:
What I like about the painting is that the dead man
faces the window and the window
is open and the oxygen
has its way with him, sings and
dances for him, makes him think
of another time, as though lying
there swimming in pallor
were part of his sleeplessness. As for
the roses whose stalks keep growing
outside, among the grass, they sprout
at the speed of his fingernails.

Fan
of the dead.

translation.title: What I Like About the Painting Is That the Dead Man...
